name: Uptime Kuma
summary: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with status pages and alerts, installed with the admin account already created.
notes: Image pinned by tag and digest. The admin account is created over the local Socket.IO API before the port is proxied, so there is no first-visitor setup window. Without a domain the dashboard is served over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate for the IP address.

licence.note: Uptime Kuma MIT. Bundled in the container: Node.js (MIT) and SQLite (public domain). Caddy (Apache-2.0) is installed on the host as the reverse proxy.
conditions: Keep the MIT copyright notice with redistributed copies
